agyos_skill.instructions: The **company-page (LINKEDIN_PAGES) strategy** — treat the page as a **credibility hub + paid launchpad** and build the real organic engine, **employee advocacy.** The agent **strategizes + designs the advocacy program + drafts page posts + drafts shareable content**; **WoopSocial publishes the page's own posts**; **employees post from their own profiles, and the first-hour engagement, paid, and native features are human/native.** LinkedIn **structurally rebalanced** the feed — **company pages get ~1–5% of feed allocation** (personal profiles ~65%) and **page organic reach fell 60–66% since 2024.** So the page's real jobs are **credibility, the official record, recruitment, and the paid launchpad** (LinkedIn Ads + **Thought Leader Ads** run exclusively from it) — **not** organic reach. **People connect with people, not logos:** the algorithm trusts individuals over brands, so the organic growth engine is **employee advocacy** (employees have ~10× the connections; ~3% who share drive ~30% of engagement; employee leads convert ~7×). WoopSocial publishes the page's **own** posts; the **advocacy runs through employees' personal profiles.** 1. **brand-profile** — positioning/voice. 2. **goals-and-kpis** — awareness vs hiring vs pipeline. (Depth: `references/the-human-framework.md`.) - **H — Hub, not megaphone:** the page = credibility hub + paid launchpad (Ads/Thought Leader Ads, announcements, recruitment, Follow button) — not the reach engine; set honest expectations. - **U — Unleash employee advocacy:** the primary organic lever (people not logos; ~10× connections, 3% → 30%, ~5× leads); a **frictionless program** (shareable content + suggested commentary employees **personalize, not identical**, Notify Employees, a pilot, light gamification, leadership math); employees post from their **own profiles** (→ `linkedin-growth`). - **M — Move in the first hour:** employees engaging within ~60 min is a strong reach signal; coordinate; executive/CEO content ~4× the page. - **A — Anchor page-appropriate content:** carousel/document (top saves), short vertical video w/ captions, custom images — **never text-only** (~0.42×); **links in comments, not body** (−60%); questions/frameworks → 437% views + saves (Depth Score). (Post craft → `linkedin-post-writer`; visuals → `ideogram`/`nano-banana`.)
